verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her W (Harsh Lesson) and E (Test of Spirit) near a tentacle wall before level 6; you win once E (Skip 'n Slash) and your core items let you kite and poke from outside her engage range.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's whole kit is built around short-cooldown engage (W, 4s CD) plus tentacles that spawn on nearby walls and heal her on hit, so standing still near terrain is how Gwen loses this lane. Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) denies targeted abilities like Test of Spirit unless Illaoi walks into the mist, and her true-damage Q plus on-hit E let her win the fight that happens away from walls. That's why the matchup is rated as Illaoi-favoured on paper but Gwen actually posts 57.4% over 509 games — the lane is winnable if you refuse her terms.

tell.watch: Illaoi's E cooldown and wall proximity

theirWindow.when: her W/E off cooldown near a wall
theirWindow.what: She'll leap in with W (Harsh Lesson, 4s CD) then rip your spirit with E (Test of Spirit, 900 range) next to a tentacle spawn — back out past 900 range or refuse the trade entirely rather than let the spirit sit on you.

yourWindow.when: her E and W are both down
yourWindow.what: Pop W (Hallowed Mist) so she must walk in to target you, then dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash) and fire Q (Snip Snip!) for its true-damage center hit, applying A Thousand Cuts before resetting out.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks off your Q snips and E on-hit swings in extended trades, and the healing conversion at full stacks offsets her tentacle sustain instead of losing a straight damage race.

summoners.why: 59.8% win rate at 72.6% pick rate — Ignite punishes her tentacle self-heal directly and Flash covers her W-leap all-in windows. Flash+Teleport (43.4% win rate, 8.1% pick) is the alternate if you're planning to split push away from her tentacle walls instead.

playing.title: Save mist for her engage
playing.detail: Pop W (Hallowed Mist) right as she leaps W (Harsh Lesson) or throws E (Test of Spirit) — she has to walk into the mist to target you, which buys the time to Q and reposition.

playing.title: Trade away from walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassable terrain, so every fight near jungle walls or river is worse for you. Force fights in open lane.

playing.title: Dash, snip, reset
playing.detail: Use E (Skip 'n Slash, 400 range) to enter, fire Q (Snip Snip!) for the true-damage center hit and passive stacks, then let E's attack-speed window carry you back out before she closes again.

playing.title: Respect the spirit timer
playing.detail: If she lands E (Test of Spirit, 900 range), get out of range before it expires — staying too close turns you into a Vessel that spawns more tentacles against you.

playing.title: Buy into her sustain
playing.detail: Oblivion Orb cuts the healing she gets back from tentacle hits, which matters more here than in most top lanes since her passive heals her on every tentacle connect.

playing.title: Poke with R before committing
playing.detail: R (Needlework, 1200 range) applies A Thousand Cuts from well outside her engage range — soften her before any all-in rather than starting the fight at melee range.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mist-timing, wall-positioning, and trade-pattern reasoning is my own read of the kit, not sourced from the stats.
